scope: Phase A pinned installer handoff and finite prerequisite diagnostics amendment; state create/read/copy/cleanup boundary, CI prepare/main/cleanup, release pin verification and focused tests

suggestions: Validate the handoff before filesystem mutation or process snapshot.
Use bounded nofollow regular-file reads in prepare and the private reader after installation.
Read back and hash the exact private installer copy.
Map a digest mismatch to install_verify_failed.
Keep stage/reason diagnostics on stderr, outside unchanged public records.

validation: Read-only actual Claude review before implementation; no native/live/networked tests or file edits.
